meta.notes: Node names and settings follow ComfyUI's official 'Text to Image (Krea-2 Turbo)' template (image_krea2_turbo_t2i.json): UNETLoader, CLIPLoader type krea2, CLIPTextEncode, ConditioningZeroOut as the negative (Turbo runs at CFG 1, so a negative prompt has no effect), EmptyLatentImage, KSampler euler/simple 8 steps denoise 1, VAEDecode. The template's optional prompt-enhance step (TextGenerate on the Qwen3-VL encoder) and style LoRA switch are left out; prompt enhancement belongs to the assistant work (proposal L2).
